newsitem.title: PERU: Lima stock exchange to list Banco Wiese ADRs.
newsitem.headline: Lima stock exchange to list Banco Wiese ADRs.

text.p: The American Depositary Receipts (ADR) of Banco Wiese will be traded on the Lima Stock Exchange starting Tuesday, bank sources said.
The ADR is a certificate used to facilitate trading in foreign shares. Banco Wiese's ADRs, which are equivalent to four ordinary shares, were trading at $6.50 in New York at 12.30 EST (1620 GMT).
In Lima, Wiese Bank's shares were trading for 4.25 soles ($1.61).
Banco Wiese is Peru's second largest financial institution in terms of deposits and investments.
